title: allionia expansa
intro: Allionia expansa, commonly known as Mexican tea, is a perennial plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving coughs, colds, and fever. The health benefits of Allionia expansa are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to soothe respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
